name: text-smear-stretch-in
title: Smear Stretch In
description: Từng ký tự bay vào từ trái, kéo dài gấp sáu và nghiêng 45° như vệt nhoè rồi co về đúng hình, ký tự cuối vào trước.

moworks.author: moworks

options.x: % of the letter's width it starts left (−250)
options.stagger: s from the last letter back (0.08)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here
credit.upstream: after Codrops (MIT); a faithful port of Codrops' effects is in the Codrops collection

moworks.notes: Split chars, pivot right-centre; each from x −250 % (of its width), rotate 45°, scaleX 6 → 0, 0°, 1 over 0.8 s power2.out (easeOutQuad), stagger 60 ms from the last char backward (demo 80 ms capped 0.7 s), from 0.3 s; opacity ramps in (recipe full at 15 %). Demo adds an accent ghost copy at the same transform, opacity 0.7 × (1 − p), as the smear. Loop exit: fade 2.65–2.95 s; loop 3 s. Params: duration (0.8 s) · stagger: từ cuối (0.06 s) · scaleX đầu (6) · rotate (45°) · x (−250 %). Pivot at the right edge; the accent tint (70 % → 0) stands in for a ghost copy at the same transform.
moworks.titleVi: Ký tự kéo vệt nhoè bay vào
